title: VoicemailRules
description: Person's voicemail passcode rules and restrictions.

blockRepeatedPatternsEnabled.description: If enabled, the passcode cannot contain repeated patterns. For example, 121212 and 123123.

blockUserNumberEnabled.description: If enabled, the passcode must not match the user's own phone number.

blockReversedUserNumberEnabled.description: If enabled, the passcode must not match the user's phone number in reverse.

blockReversedOldPasscodeEnabled.description: If enabled, the passcode must not match the user's old passcodes in reverse.

enabled.description: If enabled, passcode should not contain a numerical sequence.

numberOfAscendingDigits.description: Specifies the maximum length of an ascending numerical sequence allowed. The minimum value is 2. The maximum value is 5. Example: If this value is set to 3, then 123856 is allowed, but 123485 is not allowed (since the ascending sequence 1234 exceeds 3 digits).

numberOfDescendingDigits.description: Specifies the maximum length of a descending numerical sequence allowed. The minimum value is 2. The maximum value is 5. Example: If this value is set to 3, then 321856 is allowed, but 432185 is not allowed (since the descending sequence 4321 exceeds 3 digits).

BlockContiguousSequences.description: Settings for not allowing numerical sequence in passcode (for example, 012345 or 987654).

enabled.description: If enabled, set how many of the previous passcodes are not allowed to be re-used.

numberOfPasscodes.description: Number of previous passcodes. The minimum value is 1. The maximum value is 10.

enabled.description: If enabled, checks for sequence of the same digit being repeated.

max.description: Maximum number of repeated digit sequence allowed. The minimum value is 1. The maximum value is 6.

BlockRepeatedDigits.description: Settings to prevent single digits from being repeated in the passcode. For example, with a maximum value of 3, 111222 is allowed but 112222 is not allowed since it contains a repeated digit sequence longer than 3.

min.description: The minimum value is 2. The maximum value is 15.

max.description: The minimum value is 3. The maximum value is 30.
